oe_form_dec_compile_tactica = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_military_reforms
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_form_dec_compile_tactica_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_form_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		gold >= 100
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	option = {
		name = oe_form_dec_compile_tactica.a
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_form_dec_compile_tactica_done value = 1 }
			add_gold = -100
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_form_tactica_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_form.1
		}
	}
}
